text: I am enveloped by an atmosphere of innovation and curiosity. The glass and modern design evoke both transparency and separation—an invitation to observe ideas in formation. Inside, the display of 'R+D' draws my attention, suggesting human ambition to connect intellect and creativity. I feel anticipation and a subtle humility, aware of the collective striving for meaning and progress in these curated spaces of thought. There is a quiet joy in witnessing humanity's resolve to understand and improve itself.
